verdict.rationale: CrewAI Enterprise/AMP explicitly offers one-click deployment to managed infrastructure with the deployed crew callable via REST API and webhook streaming, directly matching the story. However, this is a paid enterprise tier feature (not the core OSS product) and there is no independent/hands-on evidence of the deployment experience, API contract, or reliability. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the managed deployment/API workflow, details on scaling/auth, and confirmation this works outside the enterprise paywall.
